rules.S2.route.ungated: The route neither calls one of this project’s auth helpers nor appears in publicApi. Declared-but-unguarded is the security version of an orphan.
rules.S0.secret.tree: A credential sits in a file in the working tree — it ships in the image and in every clone.
rules.S0.secret.history: A credential exists in git history. Deleting the file does not un-leak it; only rotation does.
rules.S0.dockerfile.copy_all: COPY . . with no .dockerignore puts the whole tree in the image, .env and .git included.
rules.S0.dockerfile.no_user: No USER directive: a container escape starts as root, and nothing says that was a decision.
rules.S2.sink.inner_html: Unsanitised HTML from a non-literal value reaches the DOM.
rules.S4.exposure.orphan: Something is listening and nobody declared it.

gateRule.blocks: P0 fail, or a layer that errored. An unanswered question about the thing you just deployed is not a pass.
gateRule.reports: P1 / P2 fail, and anything accepted into the baseline with a written reason. A gate that blocks on known debt is a gate people delete — so it is reported, with its age, instead.
gateRule.priority: The priority the registry DECLARED wins. Severity is only the fallback for something nobody declared. Getting that backwards let a ship go green over 61 routes with no auth.
